def: a cup; also a bag formoney or weights

words.word: thou shalt not have in thy bag

occurrences.text: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
words: Thou shalt not have in thy bag

occurrences.text: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.
Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
